anyOf.description: the flat body, every member optional; at least one

default_template.description: id of the template new objects of this type start from unless the create names its own or sends none; empty string clears it

default_view.description: how a set or collection of this type opens; applies to ones created after the change

icon.description: give format plus its own member: emoji, name or file

file.description: id of an image object in this space, with format file

name.description: a built-in icon name, with format icon

layout.description: the layout instances of this type get; basic unless you need another

name.description: display name, singular. Required on POST; on PATCH send it only to rename

property_definitions.description: the type's whole field list; an unknown name mints a property. On PATCH it replaces the list, so to change one field send an ops envelope with add_property to update_type instead, and to rename a property send {name} to update_property

items.description: names its property by name or by property, one of the two

format.description: the new property's format; omit it and an unknown name is created as text

name.description: the property's display name, e.g. Due date; an unknown one is created

options.description: select and multi_select only: the option vocabulary; creating options here needs the create_missing_options parameter set to true

property.description: the property by the key the space serves, for one that exists

section.description: featured shows the property on the object itself

anyOf.description: a partial type document: properties carries the type's own details, type_settings the settings to change

icon.description: give format plus its own member: emoji, name or file

file.description: id of an image object in this space, with format file

name.description: a built-in icon name, with format icon

properties.description: the type's own details, name and description only

default_template.description: id of the template new objects of this type start from unless the create names its own or sends none; empty string clears it

default_view.description: how a set or collection of this type opens; applies to ones created after the change

layout.description: the layout instances of this type get; basic unless you need another

property_definitions.description: the type's whole field list; an unknown name mints a property. On PATCH it replaces the list, so to change one field send an ops envelope with add_property to update_type instead, and to rename a property send {name} to update_property

items.description: names its property by name or by property, one of the two

format.description: the new property's format; omit it and an unknown name is created as text

name.description: the property's display name, e.g. Due date; an unknown one is created

options.description: select and multi_select only: the option vocabulary; creating options here needs the create_missing_options parameter set to true

property.description: the property by the key the space serves, for one that exists

section.description: featured shows the property on the object itself

ops.description: planned and refused whole before any write, then written in order: property ops first, view ops after, and a view op refused leaves the written property lists in place. Each op's members, schema and example come from get_op_schema with its op name

schema.description: the flat type body with the fields to change, a partial type document, or an ops envelope that edits the property list and the views one op at a time

body.description: The fields of the type to change, or an ops envelope
